Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: Sent every second for which at least one message is being generated. Contains the number of seconds since the start of 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, also called Unix Time.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Unix time (number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC)

Message.Name: Order Book Directory
Message.Description: Order book directory messages are disseminated for all active securities, including halted securities, in the Genium INET Trading system.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book. Expired Order book IDs may be reused for new instruments.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security short name

Field.Name: Long Name
Field.Description: Human-readable long name of security

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN code identifying security

Field.Name: Financial Product
Field.Description: Financial product type of the order book

Field.Name: Trading Currency
Field.Description: Trading currency

Field.Name: Decimals In Price
Field.Description: Number of decimals used in price for this order book. A value of 256 means that the instrument is traded in fractions (each fraction is 1/256)

Field.Name: Decimals In Nominal Value
Field.Description: Number of decimals in Nominal Value

Field.Name: Odd Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represents an odd lot for the order book. A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the quantity that represents a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Block Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represents a block lot for the order book. A value of 0 indicates that this lot type is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Nominal Value
Field.Description: Nominal value

Field.Name: Number Of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs. Only applicable for combination instruments

Field.Name: Underlying Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book ID of underlying instrument. Only applicable for derivative instruments except for combinations

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Only applicable for derivative instruments

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Date of order expiration. Only applicable for derivative instruments. Valid format is YYYYMMDD

Field.Name: Decimals In Strike Price
Field.Description: Number of decimals used in Strike Price for this order book. Only applicable for derivative instruments

Field.Name: Put Or Call
Field.Description: Option type. A value of 0 indicates that Put or Call is undefined for the order book

Field.Name: Ranking Type
Field.Description: Specifies what ranking type should be used. 1 = Price Time

Message.Name: Combination Order Book Leg
Message.Description: A specialized directory message used when Combination order books are traded at the marketplace. It represents both standard combinations defined by the exchange, and tailor-made combinations created by members.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Combination Order Book Id
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of the combination order book

Field.Name: Leg Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book ID of the leg instrument

Field.Name: Leg Side
Field.Description: Leg side of the combination

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg ratio

Message.Name: Tick Size Table Entry
Message.Description: Contains information on a tick size for a price range. Together, all Tick Size messages with the same order book ID form a complete Tick Size Table.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: The order book to which this entry belongs

Field.Name: Tick Size
Field.Description: Tick Size for the given price range

Field.Name: Price From
Field.Description: Start of price range for this entry

Field.Name: Price To
Field.Description: End of price range for this entry. Zero (0) means infinity

Message.Name: Short Sell Status
Message.Description: Indicates the short sell rules of an order book. Sent for order books which might have short sell allowing prior to the start of system. If an order book is absent from this message, clients should assume that the order book has no short selling rules at the start-of-day reference data messages.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier. Only applicable for Equity Market instruments

Field.Name: Short Sale Restriction
Field.Description: Specifies Short Sell status and what Short Sell validation rule should be used

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: Relays information on order book state changes.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: State Name
Field.Description: Name of Order Book State

Message.Name: Add Order No MPID Attribution
Message.Description: Indicates that a new order has been accepted by the Genium INET Trading system and was added to the displayable book. Generated for unattributed orders. The message includes an Order ID that is unique per order book and side.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order. Only unique per order book and side

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Buy or sell order

Field.Name: Ranking Sequence Number
Field.Description: Transaction-based and sequential number starting from 1. Used only in ranking logic with ranking time. Does not show order book position

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order. Orders with an undisclosed quantity will have this field set to 0

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. If bit 31 is set (MIN_INT), this represents a market order

Field.Name: Order Attributes
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace

Field.Name: Lot Type
Field.Description: Lot Type

Field.Name: Ranking Time
Field.Description: Ranking timestamp, in nanoseconds

Message.Name: Add Order With MPID Attribution
Message.Description: Note: not applicable for BIST markets. Would be generated for attributed orders and quotations entered into the Genium INET Trading system.

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: The unique identifier assigned to the new order. Only unique per order book and side

Field.Name: Order Book Id
Field.Description: Order book identifier

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Buy or sell order

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order. Orders with an undisclosed quantity will have this field set to 0

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order. If bit 31 is set (MIN_INT), this represents a market order

Field.Name: Order Attributes
Field.Description: Additional order attributes. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace

Field.Name: Lot Type
Field.Description: Lot Type

Field.Name: Participant Id
Field.Description: Market participant identifier associated with the entered order

Message.Name: End of Snapshot Message
Message.Description: Returns the current ITCH sequence number to be used when connecting to the ITCH feed. To maintain a real-time order display, firms should begin to process real-time Genium INET ITCH messages beginning with the sequence number stated in this snapshot message. After transmission, the user will be logged out immediately by the system.

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Genium INET ITCH SoupBinTCP sequence number when the snapshot was taken. To be used when logging in to the SoupBinTCP ITCH feed. While GLIMPSE is a binary feed, the SoupBinTCP sequence number is represented using ASCII characters

Bitfield.Name: Order Attributes
Bitfield.Description: Additional order attributes. Applicable types may be defined by the marketplace

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Bait Implied Order
Field.Description: Bait/implied order

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Value.Name: No Restrictions
Value.Description: Short selling is allowed with no price validation

Value.Name: Short Selling Allowed With Up Tick Rule
